about.opening: Four years ago, I picked up a camera. Somehow, it became part of me.
about.openingAlt: I'm 22. I've been making films for four years. What started as a passion became a job. Then the job became something much bigger. Now I can't really imagine doing anything else.

passion.headline: I FEEL IT IN MY BLOOD.
passion.text: Some people have a hobby. For me, this became something else. I notice light before I notice the room. I hear edits in music. I think in frames. At some point, filmmaking stopped being something I do. It became part of how I see.

whyFilm.headline: WHY FILM?
whyFilm.text: Video lets me combine everything I love into one thing people can actually feel.
